title: Coefficient extension commutes with the ordinary triangle boundary
statement: Let A,E,C be commutative rings in one universe, f:A to E and g:E to C ring maps [def-weil-module-base-change], and T any A-cochain triangle. Let phi1 and phi3 map the E-extended first and third vertices to the restrictions of their composite C-extensions. In every degree assume phi(e tensor q)=g(e) tensor q. Let k1 and k3 be their homology maps followed by the exact-restriction homology isomorphisms. For each i the actual ordinary boundary of the E-extended triangle followed by k1 in degree i+1 equals k3 in degree i followed by the restriction of the actual boundary of the C-extended triangle. No derived category, distinguishedness, flatness, or boundedness is assumed.

source.place: Lemma 10.14.3, coefficient adjunction; degreewise scalar functors in Lemma 15.61.1, expanded with ordinary homology shift naturality.

proof.text: Use the proved scalar-extension additive instance in [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model] to equip ordinary extension with its degreewise shift compatibility. Exact restriction commutes with the homology shift. Express the shift homology isomorphism as homology of shiftShortComplexFunctorIso. The scalar restriction and shift comparison agree on the three short-complex components, including the two signs. mapHomologyIso_hom_naturality then gives restriction_shift_square. Apply it after homology of T.mor3 and use exact-restriction homology naturality to obtain restriction_triangle_boundary.

The prescribed pure-tensor values imply the third-map square between the E-extended triangle and the restriction of the C-extended triangle: evaluate on 1 tensor q, using scalar-extension map_tmul and the coefficient formulas in degree j+1. Naturality of the homology shift and homologyMap_comp give the boundary square before the restriction homology isomorphisms. Compose with those isomorphisms and use restriction_triangle_boundary.

theorem scalarCoefficient_triangle_boundary
    {A E C : Type u} [CommRing A] [CommRing E] [CommRing C]
    (f : A →+* E) (g : E →+* C)
    (T : Pretriangulated.Triangle (CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ))
    (φ₁ : ((extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T.obj₁ ⟶
      ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T.obj₁))
    (φ₃ : ((extendScalars f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T.obj₃ ⟶
      ((restrictScalars g).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj
        (((extendScalars (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj T.obj₃))
    (hφ₁ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (e : E) (q : T.obj₁.X j),
      φ₁.f j (e ⊗ₜ[A,f] q) = g e ⊗ₜ[A,g.comp f] q)
    (hφ₃ : ∀ (j : ℤ) (e : E) (q : T.obj₃.X j),
      φ₃.f j (e ⊗ₜ[A,f] q) = g e ⊗ₜ[A,g.comp f] q) (i : ℤ) :
    let J := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} f).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u} (g.comp f)).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)
    CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle (J.mapTriangle.obj T) i (i + 1) ≫
        HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ₁ (i + 1) ≫
        (((F.obj T.obj₁).sc (i + 1)).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars g)).hom =
      HomologicalComplex.homologyMap φ₃ i ≫
        (((F.obj T.obj₃).sc i).mapHomologyIso (restrictScalars g)).hom ≫
        (restrictScalars g).map
          (CochainComplex.homologyδOfTriangle (F.mapTriangle.obj T) i (i + 1))
